title.en: What SCMs are sets the section order for concrete pump split piston φ260
title.zh: 辅助胶凝材料决定这篇混凝土泵分体活塞 φ260的章节顺序

description.en: What SCMs are is only the order of the sections. The cells under those headings stay the cells already printed. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists a split piston set at φ260 in rubber, rubber-cloth and polyurethane. The page does not name a pump model or a service life for this outer diameter.
description.zh: 辅助胶凝材料只决定章节顺序。标题下面的格子仍是已经印出的格子。河北品锦机械把分体活塞套件列为 φ260，材料是橡胶、橡胶夹布和聚氨酯。这一外径没有点名泵型号，也没有寿命。

h1.en: WHAT are SCMs?: concrete pump split piston φ260
h1.zh: 什么是辅助胶凝材料？：混凝土泵分体活塞 φ260

directAnswer.en: What SCMs are is only the order of the sections. The cells under those headings stay the cells already printed. A φ260 split piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai split-piston page. It is sold as a set. The materials printed for this row are rubber, rubber-cloth and polyurethane. No published pump page assigns φ260 to a model.
directAnswer.zh: 辅助胶凝材料只决定章节顺序。标题下面的格子仍是已经印出的格子。φ260 分体活塞是邢台分体活塞页上的一条外径。按套供货。这一行印出的材料是橡胶、橡胶夹布和聚氨酯。没有任何已公布泵页把 φ260 指定到某一型号。

body.en: Under the source heading “WHAT are SCMs?”, the wording that follows is the printed catalogue fragment. The split piston is a replacement set for S-valve concrete pumps, supplied from Xingtai by Hebei Pinjin Machinery. The full outer-diameter list is φ150, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ220, φ230, φ250, φ260 and φ280. This note is only the φ260 row, materials: rubber, rubber-cloth and polyurethane. Unit: set. The page does not print a compound grade, a hardness, or a service life.
body.zh: 在来源标题“什么是辅助胶凝材料？”下面，接着写的是已经印出的目录片段。分体活塞是河北品锦机械从邢台供应的 S 阀混凝土泵替换套件。全部外径是 φ150, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ220, φ230, φ250, φ260 and φ280。本文只写 φ260 这一行，材料：橡胶、橡胶夹布和聚氨酯。单位：套。页面没有印胶料牌号、硬度或寿命。

heading.en: HOW do SCMs Affect Concrete Properties?
heading.zh: 辅助胶凝材料如何影响混凝土性能？

body.en: Under the source heading “HOW do SCMs Affect Concrete Properties?”, the wording that follows is the printed catalogue fragment. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The integral-piston page is a different part. Where the same φ260 also appears there, it is still not a pump-model assignment. Electric 20's 80 mm figure is a pipe inner diameter, not a piston outer diameter.
body.zh: 在来源标题“辅助胶凝材料如何影响混凝土性能？”下面，接着写的是已经印出的目录片段。这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 整体活塞是另一件配件。若同一个 φ260 也出现在那边，仍然不是泵型号的指定。电动20的 80 mm 是输送管内径，不是活塞外径。

heading.zh: 为什么使用辅助胶凝材料？

body.en: Under the source heading “WHY are SCMs Used?”, the wording that follows is the printed catalogue fragment. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write split piston, φ260, the material row (rubber, rubber-cloth and polyurethane), and the quantity in sets. Leave life and pump model blank if the machine check is not done. Image from the source page: https://www.nrmca.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/30pr.pdf
body.zh: 在来源标题“为什么使用辅助胶凝材料？”下面，接着写的是已经印出的目录片段。邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写明分体活塞、φ260、材料行（橡胶、橡胶夹布和聚氨酯）和套数。若还没在机器上核对，寿命和泵型号留空。 图来自来源页：https://www.nrmca.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/30pr.pdf
